key.1518:
v = ""
for i=1,3 do
  v=v.."2"
  for j=1,4 do
    for k=1,8 do
      v=v..((bytes[(i-1)*5+j]>>(8-k))&1)
	end
  end
  v=v..((bytes[i*5]>>1)&1)
  v=v..(bytes[i*5]&1)
end

v=v.."300"
for i=1,27 do
  bytes[i] = tonumber(v:sub(i*4-3,i*4),4)
end

v = ""
for i=1,3 do
  v=v.."2"
  for j=1,4 do
    for k=1,8 do
      v=v..bit32.band(bit32.rshift(bytes[(i-1)*5+j],(8-k)),1)
	end
  end
  v=v..bit32.band(bit32.rshift(bytes[i*5],1),1)
  v=v..bit32.band(bytes[i*5],1)
end

v=v.."300"
for i=1,27 do
  bytes[i] = tonumber(v:sub(i*4-3,i*4),4)
end
